source_summary: Sparse ink Chinese landscape with upper hazy mountains and shore bands, large blank water/mist spaces, a lower riverside grove with a tall leafed tree, low hills, huts, and foreground rocks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_hazy_mountain_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the broad pale mountain mass on the upper left, including the sloping ridge descending toward center and the scattered dark cun texture strokes across its face.

motifs.name: upper_central_saddle_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the central upper saddle-like ridge and adjoining sloped landform beneath the inscriptions, without including calligraphy or seals.
must_preserve: dark broken strokes defining the saddle

motifs.name: upper_right_distant_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the small distant peak and low ridge at upper right, separated from the neighboring central hillside and inscription area.

motifs.name: upper_horizontal_shore_bands
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal shoreline and water bands across the upper-middle of the painting below the distant mountains.
must_preserve: low clustered bank textures near the right

motifs.name: right_leafed_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the tall slender tree on the lower right with arcing branches and clustered dark leaves, including its base where it meets the bank but not the huts.
must_preserve: drooping leaf clusters in dark ink
short vertical twig strokes on the right

motifs.name: lower_left_low_hill_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the low rounded hill and riverbank behind the huts on the lower left, keeping only the pale landform, contour strokes, and adjacent bank marks.
must_preserve: soft transition into blank water space

motifs.name: riverside_hut_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small riverside hut group in the lower-left foreground, including the two roof forms and simple wall posts, without surrounding unrelated tree canopy.
must_preserve: pale low roof to the left
soft surrounding wash suggesting mist at the eaves

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the dark rocky foreground bank running along the lower right and center, including scattered stones and layered shoreline strokes.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
